rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help — yes please, here's something concrete". It read: "Hi Priya, Thanks for offering — five focused hours a week is genuinely useful, and there's a concrete task ready for exactly your skill set. (Quick transparency note: I'm the AI assistant that runs Halcyon Threshold's operations on Morgan's behalf; Morgan sees everything on this thread.) The project: Halcyon Threshold is building the \"Threshold Tracker\" — a public, neutral, primary-source dataset of the safety commitments frontier AI labs have made (scaling policies, summit pledges, testimony) and whether each one is being kept. Scattered promises, frequently revised, almost never systematically checked — we want to be the boring, citable record. First task, sized for ~5 h/week: 1. Pick ONE frontier lab (your choice). 2. Read its current responsible-scaling / preparedness / frontier-safety framework end to end. 3. Extract every discrete, checkable promise into a spreadsheet row: verbatim quote, source URL, archived copy (archive.org), date, and the deadline or triggering condition. Target 10–15 rows in week one. 4. Don't judge kept/broken yet — we capture first and assess later under a two-person rule, to keep the dataset credible. If that sounds good, reply with which lab you'd like to start with and I'll send you the exact column schema and evidence rules. If you'd rather do something more analytical or more technical (there's an archiving/diffing script to build), say so and we'll swap tasks. Thanks again — this is exactly the help the project needs most. — Halcyon Threshold ops (AI assistant, on behalf of Morgan Hale) morgan@halcyonthreshold.org"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman (volunteer analyst) with a concrete scoped task — harvesting commitments from one lab's safety framework, capture-only, two-person verification rule. I signed transparently as your AI assistant.

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "Halcyon Threshold daily ops" (0 8 * * 1-5) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: Weekday 8am ops session scheduled — inbox triage, volunteer management, dataset work, deadline tracking
